title: CareerLens Durable Schedule Contract v1
rules: A schedule is an internal planner: it may only submit an ordinary agent run for the same user.
One (schedule_id, due_at) pair is one occurrence; repeats never create a second run.
Disabled and paused schedules reject triggers; revoked actor tokens pause the schedule and record failure.
skip policy marks occurrences older than two intervals as skipped and advances next_due past now.
run_once policy submits exactly one run for a missed occurrence, then advances normally.
Manual triggers use their idempotency-key timestamp as due_at and cannot bypass actor authorization.
